$comment: Single source of truth for the course map. Station names and order are checked against PID open data with scripts/pid_stations.py; record the feed and date in "verified" each time.

verified.source: PID GTFS open data, https://data.pid.cz/PID_GTFS.zip (feed valid 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-29)
verified.note: Order and names of all three lines match the feed. Flora (Line A) has no service in this feed window; see its status note.

milestones.name: Václavák
milestones.summary: A double milestone at the two ends of Wenceslas Square: a review of everything so far at Můstek, then the A1 can-do check at Muzeum.

milestones.name: Konečná A
milestones.summary: The A2 can-do check at the end of the line.

underConstruction: A fourth line, D, is being built from Pankrác to the southern districts.

nemocnice-motol.name: Nemocnice Motol
nemocnice-motol.aboveGround: The end of line A, at one of the country's largest hospitals.

nadrazi-veleslavin.name: Nádraží Veleslavín
nadrazi-veleslavin.aboveGround: Trolleybus 59 to the airport. Despite the name, it's a metro station, not a railway station.

dejvicka.name: Dejvická
dejvicka.aboveGround: The university district, with many students and international offices.

hradcanska.name: Hradčanská
hradcanska.aboveGround: The nearest metro station to the north side of Prague Castle.

malostranska.name: Malostranská
malostranska.aboveGround: The Lesser Town. Walk up the old castle steps or take tram 22 to Prague Castle.

staromestska.name: Staroměstská
staromestska.aboveGround: Old Town Square, the Jewish Quarter and Charles Bridge are a short walk away.

mustek.name: Můstek
mustek.aboveGround: The bottom of Wenceslas Square and the edge of the Old Town.

muzeum.name: Muzeum
muzeum.aboveGround: The top of Wenceslas Square, by the National Museum and the St Wenceslas statue ("pod koněm").

namesti-miru.name: Náměstí Míru
namesti-miru.aboveGround: Vinohrady, with the Church of St Ludmila. One of the deepest stations, with a very long escalator.

jiriho-z-podebrad.name: Jiřího z Poděbrad
jiriho-z-podebrad.aboveGround: A Vinohrady square with the striking Church of the Sacred Heart and a popular farmers' market.

status.note: No Line A trains call at Flora in the PID GTFS feed for 16–29 Nov 2026, although the station is still listed. Probably a temporary closure; the reason is not in the data. Check pid.cz before relying on it.

zelivskeho.name: Želivského
zelivskeho.aboveGround: Olšany Cemetery, where Jan Palach is buried.

smichovske-nadrazi.name: Smíchovské nádraží
smichovske-nadrazi.aboveGround: A railway station and bus terminal for trips south.

andel.name: Anděl
andel.aboveGround: A busy hub in Smíchov: offices, shopping centres and many tram lines.

narodni-trida.name: Národní třída
narodni-trida.aboveGround: The 17 November 1989 memorial is in the arcade nearby; the National Theatre is a few minutes' walk.

namesti-republiky.name: Náměstí Republiky
namesti-republiky.aboveGround: The Municipal House (Obecní dům) and the Powder Tower.

florenc.name: Florenc
florenc.aboveGround: The main coach station for international buses.

cerny-most.name: Černý Most
cerny-most.aboveGround: The end of line B, with a large shopping area and buses to the east.

letnany.name: Letňany
letnany.aboveGround: The end of line C, near the exhibition grounds.

nadrazi-holesovice.name: Nádraží Holešovice
nadrazi-holesovice.aboveGround: A railway station; buses to Troja and Prague Zoo.

vltavska.name: Vltavská
vltavska.aboveGround: Holešovice, with the Prague Market (Pražská tržnice) and contemporary art galleries nearby.

hlavni-nadrazi.name: Hlavní nádraží
hlavni-nadrazi.aboveGround: The main railway station: trains to Brno, Vienna, Berlin and beyond.

i-p-pavlova.name: I. P. Pavlova
i-p-pavlova.aboveGround: Say it "í pé Pavlova". Vinohrady's bars and cafés start here.

vysehrad.name: Vyšehrad
vysehrad.aboveGround: Walk to Vyšehrad fortress for views over the Vltava and the national cemetery.

pankrac.name: Pankrác
pankrac.aboveGround: An office district with tall towers; the future interchange with line D.

chodov.name: Chodov
chodov.aboveGround: One of Prague's largest shopping centres.

haje.name: Háje
haje.aboveGround: The end of line C, in Jižní Město, the city's largest panelák housing estate.
